briefdescription.para: Wave B integration evidence — LLM Wiki Phase B integration regressions.

detaileddescription.para:
2026-08-19
Provides 16 deterministic, self-contained integration tests covering:

LWP-INT-01: Plugin lifecycle smoke test (initialize → ingest → query → shutdown) LWP-INT-02: Phase B write→query roundtrip with hash embedding (BM25 approximation) LWP-INT-03: Concurrent query safety — 8 threads querying shared mock index LWP-INT-04: Wikipedia dump ingestion edition gate (community → PermissionDenied)
All tests are self-contained (inline mock implementations; no RocksDB, no network). The mock InMemoryWikiPlugin implements all ILLMWikiPlugin lifecycle methods.
